purpose.statement: Freeze the exact primary-source, equation, boundary, equivalence, and executable-status contract needed before any open-gravity response-scored campaign.

primary_sources.title: Die Grundlage der allgemeinen Relativitaetstheorie
primary_sources.exact_version: Annalen der Physik 49 (1916), version of record
primary_sources.operational_anchor: G_{mu nu}+Lambda g_{mu nu}=(8 pi G/c^4) T_{mu nu}; use the campaign-frozen weak-field or relativistic solution appropriate to each observable.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: G, c, Lambda and a fully declared stress-energy tensor; initial and boundary data belong to the selected GR solution.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Classical spacetime geometry and its matter, light, clock, compact-object, cosmological, and wave limits.

primary_sources.title: Does the missing mass problem signal the breakdown of Newtonian gravity?
primary_sources.exact_version: Astrophysical Journal 286 (1984), pages 7-14, version of record
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equation (3): div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) grad Phi]=4 pi G rho. Equation (5) includes a generally nonzero curl field; the algebraic MOND relation is exact only for spherical, planar, or cylindrical symmetry. Section V implements the external-field effect as a nonzero asymptotic field boundary.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze a0, the full interpolation function mu(x), baryonic rho, geometry, numerical PDE scheme, and either isolated |grad Phi|->0 or an explicit external vector field at infinity.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Nonrelativistic modified gravity for matter dynamics; high-symmetry algebraic limits and a genuine external-field effect.

primary_sources.title: Quasi-linear formulation of MOND
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Solve Newtonian Poisson first, then a second Poisson equation sourced by div[nu(|g_N|/a0) g_N]; it is action-derived but is not the AQUAL PDE.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze a0, nu(y), source density, both Poisson boundaries, geometry, and solver tolerances.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Quasi-linear nonrelativistic MOND field theory and an explicit control for confusing algebraic, AQUAL, and QUMOND formulations.

primary_sources.title: Towards a general field equation for galaxies and galaxy clusters
primary_sources.exact_version: arXiv:2602.09249v1, 9 February 2026
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equations (40)-(45): beta=-g/(r g'); g_GA=g_bar+beta f(g_GA/g0)g_GA; equivalently g_GA'=-(g_GA/r)(1-g_bar/g_GA)^(-1) f(g_GA/g0), integrated inward from r0 with g_GA(r0)=g_bar(r0)/[1-exp(-sqrt(g_bar(r0)/g0))].
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze g0, f, spherical baryonic field including exterior source support, outer radius r0, outer RAR condition, integration direction, singular handling, and tolerance. The paper uses r0=150 kpc for model galaxies and 10 Mpc for clusters under its stated less-than-1-percent doubling criterion.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Spherical galaxy and cluster acceleration phenomenology plus a stated Solar-System check; its nonspherical extension is a separate equation.

primary_sources.title: Dynamics of galaxies and clusters in refracted gravity
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equation (3): div[epsilon(rho) grad Phi]=4 pi G rho, with epsilon approximately 1 at high density and epsilon0 at low density.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze the complete epsilon(rho) law, 0<epsilon0<=epsilon<=1, critical density rho_c, transition steepness/smoothing, three-dimensional source density, geometry, outer boundary, and elliptic solver.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Proof-of-concept nonrelativistic galaxy and cluster dynamics through density-dependent gravitational permittivity.

primary_sources.title: Covariant formulation of refracted gravity
primary_sources.authors: Andrea Pierfrancesco Sanna, Titos Matsakos, and Antonaldo Diaferio
primary_sources.operational_anchor: A scalar-tensor completion with self-interaction V(phi)=-Xi phi; in the weak-field limit phi is twice the gravitational permittivity.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze Xi, scalar initial/boundary data, matter coupling, background solution, source stress-energy, and relativistic solver.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Covariant refracted-gravity completion including weak-field structure and cosmological background; it prevents treating the 2016 Poisson equation as a complete relativistic closure.

primary_sources.title: Extended MOND through gravitational potential
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equation (4): L=-rho Phi-[Lambda/(8 pi G)]F(x^2), Lambda=A0(Phi)^2, x^2=|grad Phi|^2/Lambda. Equation (5) contains both the divergence term and a potential-derivative source term; Equation (7) gives one sample A0(Phi) law.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze F, mu=dF/dx^2, the entire A0(Phi) law and its constants, the absolute-potential zero/boundary, source density, geometry, and nonlinear elliptic solver.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Potential-dependent MOND extension proposed especially for galaxy clusters.

primary_sources.title: Acceleration in Modified Gravity (MOG) and the Mass-Discrepancy Baryonic Relation
primary_sources.exact_version: arXiv:1610.06909v2, 27 October 2016
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equation (4): a=-(G_N M/r^2)[1+alpha-alpha exp(-mu r)(1+mu r)]; Equation (5) gives the extended-density convolution, with Equations (9)-(13) an equivalent Newton-plus-Yukawa potential decomposition.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze universal alpha and mu or a predeclared mass scaling, source density and geometry, convolution domain/boundary, and self-consistent extended-source solver; alpha is strength and mu inverse range.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Weak-field, nonrelativistic MOG/STVG acceleration for galaxies and clusters; not by itself the full covariant theory.

primary_sources.title: Nonlocal Gravity: Modified Poisson's Equation
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equation (2) is a nonlinear nonlocal Poisson equation with kernel K(u,v); Equations (5)-(7) give the linear Fredholm/reciprocal-kernel form rho_D(x)=integral q(x-y)rho(y)d^3y. The Tohline-Kuhn q proportional to 1/(4 pi lambda |x-y|^2) is only an explicit example, not the family definition.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze K or reciprocal q, nonlinear versus linear branch, kernel scales and regularization, full source density, integration domain, boundary, and integro-differential solver.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Newtonian limit of Mashhoon-style nonlocal gravity in which nonlocality supplies an effective source.

primary_sources.title: A universal density profile from hierarchical clustering
primary_sources.authors: Julio F. Navarro, Carlos S. Frenk, and Simon D. M. White
primary_sources.exact_version: arXiv:astro-ph/9611107v4, 21 October 1997
primary_sources.operational_anchor: rho(r)=rho_s/[x(1+x)^2], x=r/r_s; derive enclosed halo mass and add its GR/Newtonian acceleration to the declared baryonic model.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze mass/radius convention, concentration or r_s and rho_s, truncation/outer boundary, priors or training-only fit rule, baryonic nuisances, and geometry.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Collisionless cold-dark-matter halo ceiling/control for galaxies and clusters, not a source-only gravity law.

primary_sources.title: A new empirical model for the structural analysis of early-type galaxies, and a critical review of the Sersic model
primary_sources.authors: Alister W. Graham, David Merritt, Ben Moore, Juerg Diemand, and Balsa Terzic
primary_sources.exact_version: arXiv:astro-ph/0311231v2, 23 February 2004
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Equations (4)-(5): -d ln rho/d ln r=2(r/r_-2)^alpha and ln(rho/rho_-2)=(-2/alpha)[(r/r_-2)^alpha-1].
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze alpha, r_-2, rho_-2 or a mass/concentration equivalent, truncation, fit/prior rule, baryonic nuisances, and geometry.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Three-parameter curved halo-profile ceiling/control; it is not evidence for a new gravity ontology.

primary_sources.title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger
primary_sources.authors: LIGO Scientific Collaboration and Virgo Collaboration
primary_sources.exact_version: Physical Review Letters 116, 061102 (2016), version of record
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Direct interferometric strain waveform with inspiral, merger, and ringdown consistent with a binary-black-hole GR waveform.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Detector calibration, waveform family, source parameters, and noise model are observation-specific; this contract uses it only as an existence/control anchor.

primary_sources.title: Gravitational Waves and Gamma-Rays from a Binary Neutron Star Merger: GW170817 and GRB 170817A

primary_sources.claimed_domain: Multi-messenger gravitational-wave speed boundary relevant to dispersion, massive carriers, extra modes, and media.

primary_sources.title: Photons and Gravitons in S-Matrix Theory: Derivation of Charge Conservation and Equality of Gravitational and Inertial Mass
primary_sources.exact_version: Physical Review 135, B1049 (1964), version of record
primary_sources.operational_anchor: Soft massless spin-2 consistency implies universal gravitational coupling; weak excitations have helicities +/-2 and quantum energy E=hbar omega.
primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Perturbative S-matrix assumptions and a suitable background; this is not a UV completion or a galaxy acceleration solver.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Low-energy massless spin-2/graviton consistency and equivalence-control boundary.

primary_sources.title: General relativity as an effective field theory: The leading quantum corrections
primary_sources.exact_version: Physical Review D 50, 3874 (1994), version of record

primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: EFT operator basis, renormalized coefficients, background, gauge, state, and regime E much less than the Planck scale.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Controlled low-energy quantum-gravity corrections, not a full microscopic theory.

primary_sources.title: Squeezed quantum states of relic gravitons and primordial density fluctuations

primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Background expansion, mode basis, initial vacuum, squeezing amplitude/phase, observable and detector model.

primary_sources.title: On relativistic wave equations for particles of arbitrary spin in an electromagnetic field

primary_sources.parameters_and_boundaries: Mass m_g, background, source coupling, constraints, gauge/field normalization, and valid linear regime.
primary_sources.claimed_domain: Linear massive spin-2 control, not a complete nonlinear massive-gravity theory.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: For the frozen radial mapping y=x*mu_n(x), GP01-L lies in local MOND/AQUAL phenomenology. The algebraic mapping is exact for AQUAL only in spherical, planar, or cylindrical symmetry. In general three dimensions the AQUAL relation contains a curl field, so multiplying the baryonic vector field by a scalar radial law is not the full AQUAL theory.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: Success of GP01-L alone is recovery of known MOND-like behavior and cannot establish spatial history, temporal memory, or new ontology.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: AQUAL's external-field effect is a boundary-value effect requiring an explicit external vector field at infinity and a nonlinear PDE. A local acceleration formula or scalar environmental proxy is not AQUAL including EFE.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: The matched-environment discriminator cannot claim history information until the full declared AQUAL-EFE comparator is executable or the result remains SOURCE_BLOCKED.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: If W is only a single-valued function of f, integrating dGamma/ds=-W(f)dln(f)/ds produces Gamma as a local function of f up to a boundary constant. A genuine spatial-history claim requires independently specified environmental dependence or path state, and the closed-loop integrability test must be declared.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: Do not count a local integral rewrite as a new history mechanism.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: Finite-length relaxation along a declared spatial direction is a formula-level composition, not by itself evidence of historical novelty. It requires null-point rules, direction-field topology, boundary state, path independence or explicit path dependence, and a source-only environmental definition.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: Exact-combination novelty remains unestablished until independent human review and an equivalence audit are complete.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: div[exp(-Gamma) grad Phi]=4 pi G rho is formally a refracted/permittivity Poisson equation with epsilon=exp(-Gamma) when Gamma is prescribed. Making Gamma dynamic changes the coupled model, but it remains a composition of established nonlinear-permittivity and auxiliary-field motifs rather than proof of a wholly new operator.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: Freeze and test the coupled equations as a formula variant; do not claim ontology or historical novelty from the word gain.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: A quasi-static Helmholtz-like Gamma equation gives finite spatial smoothing/nonlocality. It is not temporal memory. A telegraph equation adds finite propagation for Gamma, but coupling it to an instantaneous Poisson solve does not make the entire gravity sector causal.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: Temporal-memory and causal-propagation claims require distinct versions and a complete causal closure.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: Penner's inward spherical ODE uses the complete exterior baryonic distribution and a fixed outer RAR boundary, making it the closest located published behavioral neighbor to an inward history-like galaxy/cluster law. Its beta derivative structure and boundary law are not an exact rewrite of the frozen GP01 transport equations.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: An exact structural mismatch is not proof of novelty; cite Penner and retain human review.

frozen_findings.exact_statement: The preferred-frame action target has no completed, audited covariant or conservative closure for matter, photons, lensing, redshift, tensor waves, and cosmology.
frozen_findings.promotion_consequence: Retain ACTION_PLACEHOLDER, L0_NO_LIGHT_CLAIM, and C0_ISOLATED_CONSERVATIVE; never score the placeholder as a theory.

gp01_novelty_boundary.no_negative_search_inference: Failure to locate an exact equation in this bounded source set is not evidence that no prior art exists.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: For nonrelativistic radial dynamics use g_b(r)=G M_b(<r)/r^2 with the frozen baryonic geometry; relativistic observables require the matching GR solution rather than this radial reduction.
dynamical_comparators.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze baryonic mass model, mass-to-light/gas nuisances, geometry, outer support, G, and observable-specific GR boundary conditions.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: Newtonian limit of GR; not equivalent to GR+halo or modified-gravity branches.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: g_RAR=g_b/[1-exp(-sqrt(g_b/a0))] for the local predecessor implementation; this is an empirical/algebraic control, not AQUAL.
dynamical_comparators.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze a0 and the exact interpolation expression; no external-field effect or 3D curl field is implied.
dynamical_comparators.claimed_domain: Empirical galaxy relation and frozen extrapolation control.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: Shares a high-symmetry acceleration mapping with some MOND choices but is not the AQUAL field equation.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) grad Phi]=4 pi G rho with isolated |grad Phi|->0 boundary.
dynamical_comparators.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze a0, mu, complete 3D baryonic rho, isolated boundary, grid/domain, solver, convergence and curl-field diagnostics.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: Algebraic MOND only in spherical, planar, or cylindrical symmetry; distinct from QUMOND and RAR generally.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: Solve the AQUAL PDE with an explicit nonzero vector boundary grad Phi -> -g_ext at infinity; do not replace it with a scalar local correction.
dynamical_comparators.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze a0, mu, 3D source, external-field vector magnitude/direction, domain, asymptotic boundary, solver and convergence tests.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: Not equivalent to an isolated AQUAL solve or a scalar environment label.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: g'=-(g/r)(1-g_b/g)^(-1)f(g/g0), integrated inward from the paper's frozen RAR outer condition and a declared r0.
dynamical_comparators.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze g0, f, exterior baryonic support, r0 rule, outer RAR value, integration and singular handling.
dynamical_comparators.claimed_domain: Spherical galaxies and clusters; close behavioral neighbor to inward history-like laws.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: No exact GP01 transport rewrite located; retains derivative beta and a specific outer boundary.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: div[epsilon(rho) grad Phi]=4 pi G rho using one explicitly frozen epsilon(rho); any relativistic light/GW claim requires the separate covariant scalar-tensor completion.
dynamical_comparators.parameters_and_boundaries: Freeze epsilon0, rho_c, transition shape, 3D rho, domain/boundary and nonlinear elliptic solver; freeze Xi and scalar closure for covariant use.
dynamical_comparators.claimed_domain: Density-dependent gravitational response in galaxies and clusters.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: Formal match to GP01's potential equation only when epsilon=exp(-Gamma) is prescribed; dynamic Gamma is not the same theory.

dynamical_comparators.exact_equation_or_definition: Euler-Lagrange equation from L=-rho Phi-[A0(Phi)^2/(8 pi G)]F(|grad Phi|^2/A0(Phi)^2), retaining the potential-derivative term.

dynamical_comparators.claimed_domain: Potential-dependent MOND extension for high-potential systems including clusters.
dynamical_comparators.closest_equivalence: Reduces toward an AQUAL-like form only when A0 is effectively constant and the derivative source term vanishes.

ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: Never substitute a wave-family label for a SPARC/X-COP acceleration solver.

ontology_prior_art.name: Massless spin-2 quantum field or graviton
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Quantized weak helicity +/-2 perturbations with E=hbar omega and a specified nonclassical observable or EFT correction.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Background, gauge, state, EFT coefficients, source coupling, detector and controlled low-energy regime.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Low-energy quantum description, not a UV completion.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Shares the classical GR limit; ordinary galaxy curves cannot decide classical versus quantum ontology.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: A graviton name or E=hbar omega is never an acceleration law.

ontology_prior_art.name: Quantum states of gravity
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Specify vacuum, number, coherent, squeezed, thermal, entangled, mixed or decohered state and an observable higher-order correlation or variance distinct from classical stochastic fields.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Mode basis, background, state density operator, preparation, evolution, decoherence and measurement operator.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Mathematical state construction; physical realization remains a separately labeled hypothesis.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Classical interference is not proof of a coherent graviton state.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: A state label without dynamics and observable closure is SOURCE_BLOCKED.

ontology_prior_art.name: Massive or finite-range carrier
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: E^2=p^2c^2+m_g^2c^4 and a fully specified static, screened nonlinear limit; a Yukawa point law alone is not the full theory.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: m_g/range, field content, nonlinear coefficients, source coupling, screening branch, cosmological background and boundaries.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Finite-range/dispersion tests across laboratory, binary, galaxy, cluster and cosmological scales.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: MOG has a weak-field Yukawa-like component but is not interchangeable with generic massive gravity.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: Only a separately frozen extended-source solver may enter scoring.

ontology_prior_art.name: Extra scalar, vector or tensor modes
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Declare every additional field, kinetic term, coupling, constraint, mode and matter/photon closure before deriving observables.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Full action, field content, coupling constants, background/branch, initial data, preferred frame and stability/speed conditions.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Modified propagation, preferred frames, slip, lensing and extra radiation modes.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Covariant refracted gravity is one scalar-tensor example; a generic mode name is not that theory.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: A field-content label without action and solver is SOURCE_BLOCKED.

ontology_prior_art.name: Gravitational superposition and mediated entanglement
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Prepare two source masses in spatial superposition and test a gravity-mediated phase/entanglement witness while excluding every non-gravitational channel.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Masses, separations, time, paths, phases, decoherence, witness and electromagnetic/Casimir/mechanical controls.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Entanglement would not count individual gravitons or automatically exclude every hybrid theory.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: A laboratory witness proposal has no SPARC/X-COP radial score.

ontology_prior_art.name: Semiclassical and stochastic gravity
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Mean sourcing G+counterterms=(8 pi G/c^4)<T>_ren or a derived Einstein-Langevin extension with stress-energy noise kernel.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Quantum state, renormalization, counterterms, background, collapse/branch rule if any, noise kernel and initial data.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Controlled semiclassical/stochastic approximations and separately labeled fundamental hybrids.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Page-Geilker constrains the simplest universal expectation source, not every stochastic or collapse model.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: Arbitrary fitted noise or an expectation-value name is never an executable comparator.

ontology_prior_art.name: Emergent, thermodynamic, entropic or information gravity
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Specify microscopic or operational information variables, dynamics, conservation, continuum limit and a correction distinguishable from GR.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Microstates, entropy/information rule, temperature, screen/horizon or dual boundary, couplings, dynamics and continuum regime.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Induced, thermodynamic, holographic and entropic gravity programs.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: A derivation that reproduces GR exactly cannot be selected by galaxy fits on ontology alone.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: An emergence story without a distinct frozen acceleration equation is SOURCE_BLOCKED.

ontology_prior_art.name: Discrete or causal quantum geometry
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Specify discrete events, spectra, networks or triangulations, their dynamics/measure, smooth causal limit and a derived observable correction.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Discrete state space, amplitudes/measure, constraints, causal rule, coarse graining, continuum and scale bridge.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Microscopic quantum geometry and possible derived propagation or cosmological signatures.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Planck-scale discreteness does not explain galaxies without an explicit scale bridge.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: No discrete-geometry family name may substitute for a radial solver.

ontology_prior_art.name: Medium, condensate and quasiparticle gravity
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: A literal medium must declare fields, state/equation of state, excitations, defects, coupling and preferred-frame effects; acoustic metrics alone are analogies.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Medium variables, background state, dispersion, attenuation, interactions, preferred frame, phase boundaries and continuum/GR limit.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Physical aether/medium hypotheses and explicitly separate mathematical analogue models.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Unruh's acoustic metric is an analogy; Einstein-aether is a literal dynamical vector theory.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: A medium metaphor without equations and source coupling is SOURCE_BLOCKED.

ontology_prior_art.name: Nonlocal, memory, persistence and corpuscular gravity
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: Freeze a causal kernel, boundary state, relaxation/history law or corpuscular interaction ledger and derive its static and conservation limits.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: Kernel/history state, range/time, initial and outer boundary, source support, propagation, conservation and saturation.
ontology_prior_art.claimed_domain: Spatial nonlocality, temporal memory, gain persistence and explicit corpuscular mechanisms.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: Penner is a close inward spherical neighbor; Mashhoon supplies published nonlocal kernels; neither name is GP01 automatically.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: Only a versioned kernel/history equation with solver and boundary may score.

ontology_prior_art.name: Wildcard ontology
ontology_prior_art.operational_definition: A wildcard must provide a complete typed mechanism card, exact equations, limits, conservation, prior art, distinct prediction and hard falsifier before scoring.
ontology_prior_art.parameters_and_boundaries: All required mechanism-card fields; no inferred defaults.
ontology_prior_art.closest_equivalence: No equivalence is assumed; it must be computed and audited.
ontology_prior_art.radial_substitution_rule: Wildcard is an intake lane, never an equation or solver.

light_gravity_analogies.gravity_analogue: Classical metric or extra gravitational field
light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Compare explicit field actions, sources, constraints, Green functions and static limits.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Gravity is nonlinear, universally coupled, and self-sources; shared field language is not equivalence.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Freeze wave generation, characteristic speeds, modes, phase, amplitude, damping, interference and detector coupling.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: A static field is not automatically a wave.

light_gravity_analogies.gravity_analogue: Hypothetical graviton or other quantum carrier
light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Declare spin/helicity, mass, state, packet action/energy, emission, absorption, cross-section, recoil, statistics and classical limit.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: No individual graviton has been detected; a carrier name is not an interaction model.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Specify a gravitational density operator and a higher-order correlation distinguishing it from a classical stochastic waveform.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: The same classical waveform is not evidence of quantization.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Derive an amplitude or EFT potential correction from a declared action and gauge-fixed perturbation theory.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Virtual particles are calculation elements, not observed bullets moving through time wells.

light_gravity_analogies.gravity_analogue: Tensor, vector or scalar GW polarizations
light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Derive all propagating modes and detector antenna patterns from the complete kinetic and coupling terms.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Additional modes face strong propagation, stability, preferred-frame and binary constraints.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Freeze epsilon(source) inside a field equation and derive both matter and light behavior, rather than multiplying an observed response.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: The response must arise from a complete field equation and preserve equivalence, stability and causality.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Freeze omega(k), mode content, emission timing and cosmological propagation, then predict frequency-dependent phase and arrival time.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Existing multi-messenger and waveform observations strongly limit many dispersive laws.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Solve coherent propagation through a declared geometry and detector/lens transfer function.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Classical wave interference is not quantum proof.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Define counting or correlation operator, state, detector coupling, background and classical stochastic null distribution.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: The observable must differ from classical stochastic noise and cannot be inferred from a mean galaxy field.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Freeze the mass-superposition phase protocol and an entanglement witness with exhaustive channel controls.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Entanglement requires excluding electromagnetic, Casimir, magnetic, seismic, thermal and mechanical channels.

light_gravity_analogies.gravity_analogue: Physical gravitational medium or collective mode
light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Declare the medium state, equation of state/action, excitations, defects, couplings, preferred frame, dissipation and GR limit.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: An acoustic-metric analogy is not a literal ether.

light_gravity_analogies.operational_seed: Define the quantized operator or finite mode, its eigenstates/dynamics, preparation or cosmological production, observable and continuum limit.
light_gravity_analogies.required_caution: Define what is quantized and recover the tested GR continuum before proposing a galaxy-scale bridge.

controlled_vocabularies.source_block_rule: Any required source, parameter law, boundary, geometry, external vector, absolute potential, action, or solver that is absent makes the exact branch SOURCE_BLOCKED or SOLVER_BLOCKED. The engine must retain the missing item and must not silently substitute a family name, algebraic proxy, point-source shortcut, fitted response, or another theory.
controlled_vocabularies.campaign_rebind_rule: A predecessor implementation becomes executable only after its exact code/config/data/parameter/boundary hashes are bound into the new response-blind campaign manifest; this contract does not perform that bind.

data_role_spelling.SPARC: sparc_status and sparc_missing_requirements refer to SPARC.
data_role_spelling.XCOP: xcop_status and xcop_missing_requirements refer to X-COP.

what_this_contract_establishes: A bounded primary-source map for the listed equations and ontology controls.
A fail-closed distinction between a cited family and an executable comparator.
The current local predecessor bindings and their campaign-rebind requirement.
The GP01 local/high-symmetry, EFE, integrability, permittivity, nonlocality, causality, Penner-neighbor, and action-placeholder boundaries.
what_this_contract_does_not_establish: Historical novelty, patentability, completeness of the literature, or absence of closer prior art.
Scientific truth, empirical fit quality, promotion, or authorization to score any response.
A covariant light, lensing, redshift, gravitational-wave, quantum, capture, or cosmological closure for GP01.
Executability of SOURCE_BLOCKED, SOLVER_BLOCKED, theory-only, wildcard, or analogy entries.
claim_boundary.required_next_step: Before response access, an independent human prior-art reviewer must audit novelty language and a separate campaign manifest must bind every executable comparator's exact source, equations, parameters, boundaries, code, config, data and formula hashes.
